sections.13-1-what-manual-therapy-can-and-cannot-: Manual therapy thori der ka dard ka aaraam aur movement deti hai, lekin haddi 'set' nahi karti. Isay exercise ke saath istemal karein.
sections.13-2-safety-screen-before-any-manual-the: Kisi bhi manual therapy se pehle safety screen: fracture, instability, cancer, infection aur nerve ke signs ka shak ho to nahi.
sections.13-3-selecting-a-technique-a-decision-se: Technique chunne ka tareeqa: comparable sign dhoondein, irritability ke mutabiq grade chunein, aur foran dobara test karein.
sections.13-4-the-maitland-concept: Maitland approach mein detailed examination, comparable sign aur grades I se V tak irritability ke mutabiq istemal hote hain.
sections.13-5-questions-with-answers: Sawaal hal karein. Manual therapy ka asal asar pain par nervous system ke zariye hota hai.
sections.now-you-should-be-able-to: Yeh checklist hai. Har point khud kar sakein to tick karein.
